braudelian_duration: centered on a specific event with conjunctural expansion
notes: The #sidibouzid is strongly anchored to the initial events of the Tunisian Revolution and the broader conjuncture of the Arab Spring. Its temporal dynamics are characterized by real-time circulation, multilingual synchronization, and transnational information flows. Unlike #BlackLivesMatter, #sidibouzid presents limited long-term reactivation, remaining primaly associated with the foundational event cycle of 2010-2011.
